# Java_SpringBoot_HibernateJPA

## Summary

Theory-first Java backend course progressing from Java fundamentals through
Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, SQL/JDBC, Hibernate ORM, Jakarta
Persistence, Spring transactions, DTO/API architecture, Spring Security,
testing, advanced Spring patterns, and small progression projects.

## Repository map

- `plan.md` — complete roadmap and future project ideas.
- `src/main/java` — runnable phase examples and layered application code.
- `src/test/java` — JUnit and Spring MVC/security regression tests.
- `guides/PHASE*_THEORY_QUICK_GUIDE.md` — phase explanations and boundaries.
- `guides/PROJECT1_EMPLOYEE_MANAGEMENT_GUIDE.md` — first progression project.
- `guides/PROJECT2_SPRING_CORE_INVENTORY_GUIDE.md` — Spring Core inventory project.
- `src/main/java/com/jarirahmed/projects/employeecli` — testable Java CLI.
- `src/main/java/com/jarirahmed/projects/inventory` — Spring Core inventory project.
- `src/main/resources` — Boot configuration and JPA persistence metadata.
- `pom.xml` — Maven dependencies and executable-JAR build.

## Current status

Phases 1–12 are implemented. Project 1 is an Employee Management CLI using
OOP, collections, exceptions, files, generics, streams, and tests. Project 2
is a small Spring Core inventory application using beans, DI, configuration,
services, repositories, and tests. The advanced phase documents Redis,
messaging, Docker, deployment, and operations without requiring external
services during the normal build.

## Run

```bash
mvn test
mvn package
java -jar target/java-spring-learning-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar

# Start Project 1 instead of the full lesson runner.
java -jar target/java-spring-learning-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar --project1

# Start Project 2 instead of the full lesson runner.
java -jar target/java-spring-learning-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar --project2
```

This is a learning repository. The in-memory credentials and H2 databases are
local teaching fixtures, not production configuration.
